QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_18

question.text: For a Category III AIF, the Compliance Test Report (CTR) must be submitted by the Investment Manager to the Sponsor / Trustee within:

answer.text: 15 days from the end of the financial year
30 days from the end of the financial year
60 days from the end of the financial year
Along with the annual audited accounts

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Master Circular 07-May-2024 (Annexure 12), the Cat III AIF Investment Manager must submit the CTR within 30 DAYS of financial-year-end to the Sponsor and Trustee. The Sponsor/Trustee then has 30 days to return comments; Manager incorporates within 15 days. The Trap: 15 days understates. 60 days confuses with the Cat III quarterly reporting window. 'Along with audited accounts' blurs two separate filings. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C tests this directly. XIX-C combines it with the downstream 30-day sponsor review and 15-day incorporation cycle. Manager's Pro-Tip: Build the CTR worksheet throughout the year — one sheet per disclosure item in Table 15.1 — so the 30-day post-year-end window is formality, not first-time preparation.
